text:
Marie: Kicking off regional rollout plan for v3.8.1 — US -> EU -> APAC. Will do canary smoke tests in each region and then promote if metrics stable. Change window 13:00-17:00 UTC. :rocket:
Sam: noted. what's our target steady qps and burst allowance?
Marie: target steady 350 qps, short burst to 500 qps for <10m. Pass criteria: CPU <80%, GPU <85%, 95p latency <300ms, errors <1.5%. If any fails, hold and investigate.
deploy-bot: deploy started: release=v3.8.1 stage=canary region=us-east-1 by=@marie
Raj: launching smoke load now — 50 rps ramp, monitoring KV cache hit and batching stats.
Lucy: observing GPU util ~82% on us-east canary under that probe. Holding EU promotion until we see a steady 5-minute window <80%.
Marie: understood. pin fallback model in EU to v3.8.0 incase we need instant revert. Sam, can you add that to the rollout metadata?
Sam: done — pinned model v3.8.0 in eu-west-1 as fallback. Also set canary auto-rollback threshold: errors >3% for 2 consecutive minutes OR 95p latency > 2x baseline. Manual signoff required for region promote.
opsbot: smoke-test results (us-east-1): rps=50, 95p_latency=210ms, errors=0.6%, KV_hit=72%, GPU_util=79%
Lucy: after reducing batching to 8 and forcing continuous batching window tweak, 95p down to 185ms and GPU util to 76%. Good to promote US.
Marie: promote US to regional promotion at 13:22 UTC. EU test next. APAC held until next-day change window unless manual override.
Raj: preparing EU probe — ramp to 150 rps over 6min, watching cache hit and kernel dispatch latency.
Sam: reminder: ops playbook step — if CPU>78% and tail latency worsens, we should increase batch timeout or throttle new connections. Also permit a one-time reserved GPU bump (+1) if util >85% for 3m to avoid rollback.
Marie: enable reserve +1 GPU in eu-west if pressure >85% for 3m. Auto-rollback only on canary; promotions require manual ack in thread.
deploy-bot: canary check complete for us-east-1 — status=SUCCESS, metrics_ok=true
opsbot: eu-west-1 smoke start: rps=30 -> 150, 95p_latency=340ms @ramp peak, errors=1.9%, GPU_util=88%
Lucy: eu-west looks borderline — 95p 340ms > 300ms threshold. Trying smaller batch size and increased kernel concurrency.
Raj: rolling back eu-west canary to v3.8.0 pinned fallback while we debug kernel dispatch patterns.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: region=eu-west-1 to= v3.8.0 reason=95p_latency_exceeded
Marie: good call on rollback. Add a note to release notes: partial EU rollback during canary due to latency regressions, US unchanged.
Sam: adding runbook note and opening a follow-up ticket: infra-invst-221 latency regression kernel scheduling in eu-west.
Lucy: for APAC, recommend deferring to next business day window. If we need faster, we can schedule a controlled stress with reserved capacity.
Marie: final plan: US promoted, EU rolled back to pinned v3.8.0 and investigation ticket created, APAC postponed. Will follow up with post-mortem and updated rollout checklist. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
Sam: will post summary to #eng-releases and update change log: "v3.8.1 regional progressive rollout: US promoted, EU canary rolled back due to latency; APAC deferred."
Marie: closing here — keep monitoring dashboards for the rest of the window and escalate if anything unusual.
